params.notes: The FTC's 2024 Non-Compete Clause Rule (16 C.F.R. Part 910) was set aside nationwide in Ryan LLC v. FTC (N.D. Tex., 2024-08-20) and the FTC dropped its appeal in September 2025; the agency pursues case-by-case enforcement under FTC Act § 5. State law governs enforceability.

result.summary: No federal rule bans non-competes: the FTC's 2024 rule was vacated, so state law controls.
